core_values: Opposition to elite capture of institutions
Protection of domestic workers and industries

economic_policy.taxation: Tax the rich and corporations heavily; eliminate tax loopholes used by the wealthy; no new taxes on working families; windfall profit taxes on large corporations.
spending_priorities: Jobs and wage growth for working families
economic_policy.trade: Protectionist trade policy; tariffs on imports that undercut domestic workers; renegotiate trade deals that shipped jobs overseas; buy-domestic procurement rules.
economic_policy.regulation: Break up monopolies and Big Tech; regulate Wall Street strictly; oppose regulations that burden small businesses while favouring corporations.

social_policy.healthcare: Affordable healthcare for all through price controls and public negotiation; cap insulin and drug prices; crack down on pharmaceutical profiteering.
social_policy.education: Invest in vocational training and community colleges; make trades as respected as university degrees; oppose student loan predation; local control of schools.
social_policy.housing: Cap rents in high-cost areas; crack down on corporate landlords and housing speculation; first-time homebuyer assistance for working families.
social_policy.civil_rights: Equal treatment under the law for all citizens; oppose identity politics that divide working people; focus on class-based solidarity.
social_policy.immigration: Reduce immigration to protect domestic wages; penalise employers who exploit undocumented labour; secure borders; oppose both open borders and family separation.

governance.decentralization: Binding referenda on major policy decisions; town-hall democracy; break the power of unelected bureaucrats and lobbyists.
governance.transparency: Full financial disclosure for all elected officials; ban stock trading by members of congress; mandatory lobbying transparency; term limits.
governance.electoral_reform: Recall elections for underperforming officials; ban super PACs; publicly funded elections; citizen initiative process at all levels.

environment.climate_action: Support clean energy jobs but oppose carbon taxes that raise costs for working families; hold corporate polluters accountable rather than punishing consumers.
environment.energy: Energy independence through domestic production; support fossil fuel workers during transition; invest in clean energy manufacturing jobs at home.
environment.conservation: Protect public lands for recreation and local economies; hold corporations liable for environmental damage; clean water as a right.

security.defense: Strong defence but end endless wars; bring troops home; spend defence dollars on domestic needs; take care of veterans first.
security.law_enforcement: Tough on violent crime and corruption; fund local police; crack down on drug cartels and human trafficking; oppose defunding police.
security.foreign_policy: Put domestic interests first; skeptical of international institutions that don't serve ordinary people; oppose foreign aid to corrupt governments.
